name: Uzushio
description: The 4th NHK Asadora. Starring Michiko Hayashi as a woman born in poverty who lives a brave life. She lost her husband in war and now must take care of their 5-year-old child alone.  Adapted from the novel of the same name by Fumiko Hayashi.

videos.title: TWA Flight 800
videos.overview: In July 1996, one of the worst aviation disasters in American history leaves 230 people dead and countless questions unanswered; it's a tragedy that changes the aviation industry forever.
